scientific_question: Does natural-image spatial CLIP information contain stable relevant-object or EE-object-relative local-dynamics signal beyond the frozen global 512-D CLIP representation, rather than merely additional robot/image-motion detail?

frozen_upstream.transitive_ledger: The frozen visual-target and missing-state protocols transitively hash-check C0-v2, C1-v2.1 candidate generation and production scale, D13/D14/D15, WM-v2A/B/B.1/C-EJ, matched RGB/state branches, and all earlier reports/results/checkpoints.

scope.bootstrap_and_split_unit: task-stratified matched branch point retaining all three candidate pairs and eight horizons

calibration.use: PCA/ridge fit, alpha selection, target localization thresholds

development_evaluation.use: one-shot frozen development evaluation; explicitly not blind confirmation

natural_image_contract.masked_clip_variants: historical reference only and never read by this analyzer
natural_image_contract.global_feature: full natural image -> frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 visual_projection -> L2 normalize [512]
natural_image_contract.patch_feature: same natural image -> last_hidden_state[:,1:] -> post_layernorm -> visual_projection -> per-token L2 normalize [49,512]

semantic_fractional_coverage.source: frozen native MuJoCo geom segmentation aligned to 7x7 CLIP cells by nearest 224x224 resize and exact 32x32 mean pooling
semantic_fractional_coverage.pair_rule: arithmetic mean of the two candidate-frame patch coverage vectors
semantic_fractional_coverage.interpretation: fractional pooling only; dominant labels are never treated as pure semantic patches

interaction_region.candidate_frame_rule: active iff a patch overlaps both robot and relevant-object masks, or its center is within 32 native 128x128 pixels of both masks
interaction_region.pair_rule: logical union of the two candidate-frame indicators
interaction_region.threshold_selection: fixed a priori as one CLIP patch width at 224px mapped to the native 128px image; not tuned on either partition

robot: EE translation norm in frozen train-standardized proprio coordinates
object: maximum relevant-object translation norm in simulator world coordinates
external_targets.contact_secondary: same versus different four-way actual MuJoCo contact state
external_targets.deployment_role: diagnostic oracle only; no future simulator variable is a model/controller input

global_summary_10d: first eight calibration-fitted global-differential PCA scores
equal_capacity_summaries.global_plus_patch_20d: concatenate the frozen 10-D global and 10-D patch summaries
equal_capacity_summaries.target_models: independent closed-form ridge probes with calibration-only standardization and intercept

equal_rank_pca.patch_input: signed flattened 49x512 patch differential; no prior global averaging
equal_rank_pca.algorithm: deterministic randomized SVD with oversample 8 and two power iterations

probes.selection: leave-one-init-state-out CV inside init31-34; minimum mean fold RMSE; exact ties choose larger alpha

contact_probe.model: balanced L2 logistic ridge on the exact same frozen representation inputs
contact_probe.verdict_role: secondary only; never authorizes or blocks redesign

shuffle.rule: derange only the named patch group across branch points within identical task, horizon, and candidate pair; global features and targets stay fixed

bootstrap.unit: task-stratified matched branch point retaining all 24 correlated pair/horizon rows

gates.increment_ci_rule: global+patch versus global relative RMSE improvement CI lower > 0
gates.patch_shuffle_rule: all-patch shuffle relative degradation > 0 and CI lower > 0
gates.target_pass: all aggregate increment, CI, patch-shuffle, task, horizon, and pair conditions pass
gates.family_pass: at least one preregistered scalar target in the family passes target_pass
gates.interaction_pass: relative family passes and interaction-only shuffle passes for at least one passing relative target
gates.authorization: object or relative family pass; robot-only evidence can never authorize redesign

forbidden: Do not run a simulator; all natural RGB, masks, patch/global features, and state truth already exist in frozen sidecars.
Do not modify or mask natural RGB and do not use historical masked-image CLIP variants as relevance evidence.
Do not access init states 40-49 or any reward, done, success, or task outcome.
Do not train or modify a World Model, CLIP encoder, actor, candidate generator, perturbation scale, reranker, or controller.
Do not run C1/C2, D20-v2, seed23/47, or controller success evaluation.
Do not overwrite any upstream result, report, checkpoint, sidecar, config, or tag.
